A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Zongorlu system/Legends|Zongorlu system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3963 BBY]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was the first battle along one of the three invasion corridors by which the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] invaded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]; after [[Taris Siege|invading]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces headed out along the northern edge of the Republic, and after conquering the Zongorlu system, the Neo-Crusaders moved on to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] and [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It was marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
